component.name: azure-key-vault
component.title: Azure Key Vault
component.description: Create, get, update, delete and purge secrets in Azure Key Vault.
component.label: cloud

configuration.description: The configuration that each endpoint of the component starts from, as a copy. The options of the endpoint replace its values.

credentialType.label: common
credentialType.description: How the endpoint authenticates when it creates the SecretClient. CLIENT_SECRET uses the clientId, clientSecret and tenantId options. AZURE_IDENTITY uses the DefaultAzureCredential of the Azure Identity library, which tries environment variables, workload identity, managed identity and developer tools such as the Azure CLI. Not used when the secretClient option is set.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAzureKeyVaultProducerOperation header replaces this option. Every operation except updateSecretProperties takes the name of the secret from the CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretName header.

secretClient.description: To use a custom com.azure.security.keyvault.secrets.SecretClient. When this option is set, the client decides the vault and the credentials, and the vaultName, credentialType, clientId, clientSecret and tenantId options are not used to connect.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

clientId.label: security
clientId.description: The client ID (application ID) of the Microsoft Entra application for the CLIENT_SECRET credential type. Required for CLIENT_SECRET, the default, unless the secretClient option is set. Not used for AZURE_IDENTITY.

clientSecret.label: security
clientSecret.description: The client secret of the Microsoft Entra application for the CLIENT_SECRET credential type. Required for CLIENT_SECRET, the default, unless the secretClient option is set. Not used for AZURE_IDENTITY.

tenantId.label: security
tenantId.description: The ID of the Microsoft Entra tenant (directory) of the application for the CLIENT_SECRET credential type. Required for CLIENT_SECRET, the default, unless the secretClient option is set. Not used for AZURE_IDENTITY.

CamelAzureKeyVaultProducerOperation.label: producer
CamelAzureKeyVaultProducerOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretName.label: producer
CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretName.description: The name of the secret, required by every operation except updateSecretProperties. createSecret adds a new version when the secret already exists, and getSecret returns the value of the latest version.

CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretProperties.label: producer
CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretProperties.description: The SecretProperties for updateSecretProperties, which requires this header. Its name and its version select the secret. Only the attributes that are set in it, such as enabled, expiresOn, notBefore, contentType and tags, are changed, and the value of the secret is not.

producerIn.description: The value of the secret for createSecret, the default: text, bytes, a stream or a file is read as text, and a Map, a List or a POJO is stored as JSON, of which the azure properties function can read a field. No body fails. The name of the secret is in the CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretName header, and updateSecretProperties takes the SecretProperties from the CamelAzureKeyVaultSecretProperties header: the other operations do not use the body

producerOut.description: The KeyVaultSecret of the SDK for createSecret, the default; the value of the secret as text for getSecret; the SecretProperties for updateSecretProperties; the DeletedSecret for deleteSecret, which waits until the secret is deleted, with the recovery id and the dates of the deletion and of the scheduled purge

vaultName.description: The name of the key vault. The endpoint builds the vault URL from it with the vault.azure.net domain of the Azure public cloud. Not used to connect when the secretClient option is set.
